62307.name: Resistor Drive – ATK
62307.SpecificEffects:
No ST type restriction.
DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-25%</color> from Tactical Attacks. Effects of the same type cannot stack.
When any enemy actively uses Tactical Weapons to attack, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=623076>[Countercharge]</buf> before combat. If this unit is the target, gains an additional <color=#F74848>1</color> stack. Upon gaining <color=#F74848>6</color> stacks of <buf ID=623076>[Countercharge]</buf>, restores <color=#F74848>15%</color> HP to all parts and regens <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat. All stacks are removed after triggering, and no more <buf ID=623076>[Countercharge]</buf> stacks can be gained this turn.
In combat, enemy DMG <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
